reading.body:
Indiana University operates a data center on the Bloomington campus at 2750 East Discovery Parkway, confirmed as university-owned infrastructure in September 2026. The facility's IT capacity is not published. Indiana has six mapped data center facilities, of which only two publish power figures totaling 22.5 MW across the state.

This campus ranks third among Indiana facilities by published capacity, but that ranking reflects only two facilities in the state reporting power draw at all. Whether the Bloomington data center serves enterprise IT, research computing, or both is not specified in available sources. The facility's role in AI infrastructure cannot be assessed without published power or rack capacity.

University-operated computing facilities typically serve research workloads rather than commercial cloud or training operations. Confirmation of this site's specific building identity, current capacity, and tenant mix would require direct contact with Indiana University's IT services, which was not completed in available research time.
